summary: Defined platform process-tree termination, observable cleanup settlement, and post-deadline error ownership.

items.title: Descendant termination has no concrete target
items.rationale: Specified POSIX detached process groups and negative-PGID signals plus win32 taskkill tree termination, with no new package dependency.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[1..2], overview.decisions[4], requirements[0], requirements[3], and tasks[0] now define tree ownership and platform behavior.

items.title: Grace expiry is treated as terminal before death is observable
items.rationale: Separated forced-termination dispatch from terminal settlement and required direct close plus a platform tree-dead observation within a cleanup margin.
items.evidence: spec.json design_principles[3], overview.data_flow[3], requirements[1], requirements[3], and acceptance_criteria[1] now require observable cleanup.

items.title: Close after timeout has no caller-visible error contract
items.rationale: Made deadline ownership atomic: pre-deadline outcomes retain their contract, while every post-deadline close becomes a structured AgentTimeoutError after cleanup.
items.evidence: spec.json design_principles[2], overview.data_flow[3], overview.decisions[5], requirements[2], acceptance_criteria[3], and tasks[1] now define the grace-window close result.
